	hidden_trigger = { COLDWAR_CHL_is_scenario = yes }
	country_exists = BOL
	country_exists = COL
	country_exists = ECU
	country_exists = PRU
	hidden_trigger = {
		NOT = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_CHL_dip_andean_protocol_signed }
	}
	hidden_trigger = {
		NOT = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_CHL_dip_andean_protocol_pending }
	}
	hidden_trigger = {
		NOT = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_CHL_dip_andean_protocol_cooldown }
	}
	custom_trigger_tooltip = { tooltip = COLDWAR_CHL_dip_andean_protocol_relations_tt COLDWAR_CHL_dip_andean_protocol_clear = yes }
	CHL = { has_idea = COLDWAR_CHL_cartagena_member }
	BOL = { has_idea = COLDWAR_CHL_cartagena_member }
	COL = { has_idea = COLDWAR_CHL_cartagena_member }
	ECU = { has_idea = COLDWAR_CHL_cartagena_member }
	PRU = { has_idea = COLDWAR_CHL_cartagena_member }
	hidden_trigger = {
		CHL = {
			NOT = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_CHL_dip_andean_protocol_signed_chl }
		}
	}
	hidden_trigger = {
		BOL = {
			NOT = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_CHL_dip_andean_protocol_signed_bol }
		}
	}
	hidden_trigger = {

		}
	}

		}
	}
